Loss report: drone -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test step.action: actions/checkout step (Drone clones the repository before the steps (https://docs.drone.io/pipeline/docker/syntax/cloning/); clone.depth maps to the step input, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/ship job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/ship step.action: actions/checkout step (Drone clones the repository before the steps (https://docs.drone.io/pipeline/docker/syntax/cloning/); clone.depth maps to the step input, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/ship/step/ship step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[native] pipeline/ci/job/test/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/deploy/job/ship/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
